Name: My Hero Valley Name Conversion
Author: TheDevilRoll
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]This mod is a Dialogue conversion mod for my replacement mods  ex: Aizawa as Sebastian, Hizashi as Sam.[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]any my hero characters are not my original characters, all rights go to Kōhei Horikoshi and Hideyuki Furuhashi. [/color]

[b][size=4]1.1.0 release.[/size][/b]
[b]I fixed some nicknames i noticed were missing: "SAM" to "HIZASHI" thanks vincent for teaching me that sam's name in all caps is considered different to the game. also "Seb" to "Sho" because i got sebby but not seb. TnT. Also a clarification to the pronouns option: this just offers gender neutral for all my nonbinary's and nonspecific, etc. (ex: She to They, His to Theirs, Her to Them, etc) [/b]

[size=5][b]Also big news this is multiplayer compatible. Thank you to my best for testing this with me.[/b][/size]

[color=#d4d4d8][size=4][b]1.0.0 release.[/b][/size][/color]
[color=#d4d4d8][b]Abigial's name is changed to Nemuri already but my sprites for her are not yet ready to upload. they'll be added soon. you can temporarily remove the dialogue for her by using GMCM. This mod will convert dialogue and names when called to their names. for example Sebastian will be labeled as Sho (Nickname) or Shouta depending on if a character would usually say Sebby or Sebastian.[/b] [/color]

[color=#d4d4d8][b]This mod will be updated every time i create a new character. this is just a mod that supports my replacements and makes it easier for dialogue to match the characters. I didn't want to have to edit every dialogue so i made a "if this then this" Mod.[/b][/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
1. Install SMAPI
2. Install Generic Mod Config Menu
3. Extract this mod into your Stardew Valley Mods folder
4. Launch the game using SMAPI 

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]This mod changes any names in dialogue.[/color]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Requires SMAPI and Generic Mod Config Menu[/color]
